CustomField.label: Instrument Branch Path
CustomField.description: Which question actually filled each slot, as JSON: base slot key -> variant key (or "default" where no branch fired). Instrument_Pair__c says which pack was used; this says which PATH through it was walked, and the two together are what let a year-old Section_Scores__c blob be read back as the eight questions the prospect was really asked. Server-derived from the submitted answers; a client cannot influence it except through the answers themselves.
